value.rationale: A connected, reversible, unit-weight tree realizes two disjoint positive-length intervals of stochastic positivity for a commonly used fourth-order implicit heat integrator, with a sharp 12-vertex transition inside its natural parameterized family. The exact all-size classification, recovery mechanism, and asymptotic shrinking of positivity components are useful structural numerical stability information rather than a generic method-level observation.
